subject.title: fix(vydra): stop hanging when generated asset downloads drip forever

question: Should the timeout-aware text-body reader be added as a supported Plugin SDK response-limit API, or should Vydra use an existing supported bounded-reader path?
rationale: The submitted fix needs body cancellation plus bounded text extraction, but the referenced public SDK API does not exist; choosing the permanent plugin-facing contract is an owner-boundary decision.

options.title: Add a narrow SDK reader
options.body: Expose a documented timeout-aware bounded text-snippet reader, cover it in the SDK, and use it from Vydra for non-2xx details.

options.title: Use an existing public contract
options.body: Rework Vydra to use an already exported bounded response reader only if it can preserve the same wall-clock cancellation semantics.

recommendation.title: Add a narrow SDK reader
recommendation.body: Expose a documented timeout-aware bounded text-snippet reader, cover it in the SDK, and use it from Vydra for non-2xx details.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently landed closely related timeout behavior and can supply the immediate implementation context, while the SDK boundary still needs maintainer confirmation.
